verdict.rationale: The evidence pack includes an explicit probe (mistral-probe-2) checking standard OpenAPI spec locations (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json), all returning 404. While Mistral has extensive human-readable API reference docs (mistral-supp-models-endpoint, mistral-docs-1), there is no evidence of a downloadable machine-readable spec file.
